findings.evidence: `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Spin/Real/Stabilizer.lean:150-178` already hosts the algebraic last-unit-vector material (`realCliffordSpinLastStabilizer`, `mem_realCliffordSpinLastStabilizer_iff`) stated with `spinVectorAction` and `Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1`, while `Spin/Real/Basic.lean:11` already imports `Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt`; only lines 80-83 and 156-190 of the new file mention `IsOpen`/`Continuous`.
findings.fix: Move the neighborhood set, the direction definition with its unit-form law, the section definition, `_apply`, and `_action` (with their private helpers) to a new file under `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Spin/Real/` (e.g. `Real/SphereSection.lean`, next to `Real/Stabilizer.lean`), and keep only `isOpen_realCliffordSpinLastUnitNeighborhood` and `continuousOn_realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection` in the Topology file, importing the new module.
findings.issue: Six of the eight public declarations use no topology: `realCliffordSpinLastUnitNeighborhood` (:66), `mem_realCliffordSpinLastUnitNeighborhood` (:73), `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection` (:100), `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection_form` (:107), `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection` (:135), `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection_apply` (:142), `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection_action` (:195), plus the private helpers (:56-131). They depend only on `realCliffordForm`/`posDef_realCliffordForm_zero` (LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/RealForm.lean), `spinReflectionPair`/`coe_spinToSpecialOrthogonal_spinReflectionPair` (LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Spin/ReflectionPair.lean), `QuadraticMap.reflection_sub_apply_eq_of_map_eq`/`reflection_smul_eq` (LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/OrthogonalGroup.lean) and `Real.sqrt`. Placing them in the topology tree forces any algebraic consumer of the Spin-action transitivity statement to import the topology stack.

summary: The new file correctly joins the existing Topology Spin subdirectory and its imports are clean, but the bulk of it is non-topological: the neighborhood, direction, section, and the action equation depend on no topology and belong in the earlier LinearAlgebra Spin/Real tree, leaving only the openness and continuity theorems in the Topology file.
